$comment: Shared conformance vectors for the form-rules engine; see form-rules.md. Compared fields: expected.* only (messages are not compared). errors are compared as a set of {fieldKey, code}.

vectors.name: text-required-missing
vectors.description: Static required TEXT with no value yields REQUIRED.

vectors.name: text-required-whitespace-only
vectors.description: A string made only of ASCII whitespace (space, tab, LF, CR) is empty, so required fails.

vectors.name: text-value-kept-untrimmed
vectors.description: Non-empty text is persisted exactly as submitted (no trimming).

vectors.name: text-optional-empty-omitted
vectors.description: Optional TEXT submitted as empty string: no error and omitted from normalized values.

vectors.name: text-wrong-json-type
vectors.description: TEXT given a JSON number: INVALID_TYPE (no coercion).

vectors.name: text-too-long
vectors.description: maxLength counts UTF-16 code units; 6 > 5 yields TOO_LONG.

vectors.name: text-max-length-boundary-ok
vectors.description: Exactly maxLength characters is allowed.

vectors.name: text-pattern-mismatch
vectors.description: pattern is an unanchored ECMAScript regex search; "ABC-12" does not match ^[A-Z]{3}-\d{4}$.

vectors.name: text-pattern-match
vectors.description: Matching value passes pattern.

vectors.name: text-eq-is-ascii-case-insensitive
vectors.description: eq on TEXT folds ASCII case only: "ACME" equals literal "acme", so the dependent field is shown.

vectors.name: text-eq-non-ascii-is-exact
vectors.description: Non-ASCII letters are NOT case folded: "É" does not equal "é", so the dependent field stays hidden and its value is dropped.

vectors.name: url-valid-and-invalid
vectors.description: URL must be an absolute http/https URL; the second field fails with INVALID_TYPE.

vectors.name: number-above-max
vectors.description: NUMBER above validation.max yields OUT_OF_RANGE.

vectors.name: number-at-bounds-ok
vectors.description: Bounds are inclusive.

vectors.name: number-string-is-invalid-type
vectors.description: No coercion: the JSON string "12" is INVALID_TYPE for NUMBER.

vectors.name: number-zero-satisfies-required
vectors.description: 0 is a value, not empty: required is satisfied and 0 is persisted.

vectors.name: number-required-when-gt
vectors.description: requiredWhen gt: volume 1500 > 1000 makes justification required; 1000 would not.

vectors.name: number-boundary-gt-not-required
vectors.description: gt is strict: volume 1000 does not make justification required.

vectors.name: number-invalid-type-reads-as-null-in-rules
vectors.description: A type-invalid value reads as null in rules: neq on null is true, so the dependent field is shown (INVALID_TYPE still reported).

vectors.name: checkbox-false-satisfies-required
vectors.description: false is an answer: a required CHECKBOX with false passes; only null/absent fails.

vectors.name: checkbox-absent-required
vectors.description: Required CHECKBOX with no value: REQUIRED.

vectors.name: checkbox-string-is-invalid-type
vectors.description: No coercion: the JSON string "true" is INVALID_TYPE.

vectors.name: checkbox-true-shows-and-requires
vectors.description: requires_ocr=true shows ocr_language and makes it conditionally required; it is missing, so REQUIRED.

vectors.name: checkbox-false-hides-and-drops-value
vectors.description: requires_ocr=false hides ocr_language; the submitted value is dropped silently (no error, not persisted).

vectors.name: checkbox-unanswered-isfalse-is-false
vectors.description: isTrue and isFalse are both false on an unanswered checkbox; not(isTrue) is true.

vectors.name: select-valid-option
vectors.description: SELECT with a declared option key is accepted.

vectors.name: select-unknown-option
vectors.description: SELECT value not among declared options: OPTION_NOT_ALLOWED.

vectors.name: select-option-keys-case-sensitive
vectors.description: Option keys are compared exactly: "FAST" is not "fast".

vectors.name: select-number-is-invalid-type
vectors.description: SELECT value must be a string.

vectors.name: radio-eq-show-when
vectors.description: RADIO eq (exact, case-sensitive) controls visibility.

vectors.name: select-in-and-notin
vectors.description: in / notIn on a SELECT: "full" is in [full, deep] and not in [fast].

vectors.name: select-neq-on-empty-is-true
vectors.description: Comparisons against null are false except neq / notIn / isEmpty: neq on an unanswered SELECT shows the field.

vectors.name: option-availability-filters-set
vectors.description: Option availableWhen filters the offered set: country=us leaves [ny, any].

vectors.name: option-unavailable-selected-rejected
vectors.description: Selecting an option whose availableWhen is false yields OPTION_NOT_ALLOWED even though it is declared.

vectors.name: option-availability-reads-null-when-source-empty
vectors.description: availableWhen reading an empty field sees null: eq is false, so only unconditional options remain.

vectors.name: multiselect-valid-keeps-order
vectors.description: Valid selection is persisted in submitted order.

vectors.name: multiselect-one-bad-key
vectors.description: One undeclared key yields exactly one OPTION_NOT_ALLOWED for the field.

vectors.name: multiselect-duplicate-is-invalid-type
vectors.description: Duplicate keys in a MULTISELECT array: INVALID_TYPE.

vectors.name: multiselect-empty-array-required
vectors.description: An empty array is empty: a required MULTISELECT fails with REQUIRED.

vectors.name: multiselect-contains-shows-field
vectors.description: contains tests membership of the selection; "pdf" is selected so pdf_options is shown, tiff_options is hidden.

vectors.name: multiselect-not-contains-on-empty
vectors.description: contains on an empty MULTISELECT is false, so not(contains) is true.

vectors.name: date-valid-in-range
vectors.description: Valid date inside [min, max].

vectors.name: date-before-min
vectors.description: Date before min: OUT_OF_RANGE.

vectors.name: date-impossible-calendar-day
vectors.description: 2026-02-30 is not a real date: INVALID_TYPE.

vectors.name: date-wrong-format
vectors.description: Only yyyy-MM-dd is accepted: 2026-6-30 and "06/30/2026" are INVALID_TYPE.

vectors.name: date-gte-rule-ordinal
vectors.description: Date rules compare chronologically (ordinal on yyyy-MM-dd): 2026-03-01 >= 2026-01-01 shows rush_reason, < 2026-02-01 would not.

vectors.name: datetime-format
vectors.description: DATETIME must be ISO-8601 UTC with Z: the offset form is INVALID_TYPE.

vectors.name: user-ref-integer-only
vectors.description: USER_REF / ASSET_REF are positive integers; existence is a server concern outside these vectors.

vectors.name: nested-and-or-true-via-second-branch
vectors.description: a AND (b=x OR c): a=true, b=y, c=true => shown and required.

vectors.name: nested-and-or-false
vectors.description: a AND (b=x OR c): a=true, b=y, c=false => hidden; submitted value dropped.

vectors.name: nested-and-or-outer-false
vectors.description: a=false short-circuits the AND even if b=x.

vectors.name: nested-depth-three-ok
vectors.description: or(and(a,b),c) has depth 3 (leaf=1, and=2, or=3), the maximum allowed, so the definition is valid.

vectors.name: not-operator
vectors.description: not inverts: not(eq(b, x)) with b=y is true.

vectors.name: hidden-required-is-not-required
vectors.description: A statically required field that is hidden is not required and produces no error.

vectors.name: hidden-value-reads-as-null-for-dependents
vectors.description: A hidden field reads as null: b is hidden (a=false) so c, which needs b=x, is hidden too even though b=x was submitted.

vectors.name: hidden-invalid-value-is-silently-dropped
vectors.description: Hidden fields are not validated: an invalid-typed value for a hidden field is dropped without error.

vectors.name: section-hidden-hides-members
vectors.description: Fields in a hidden section inherit hidden: adv_note (required) is hidden, not required, and dropped.

vectors.name: section-visible-shows-members
vectors.description: With the section visible, adv_note (required) is enforced.

vectors.name: draft-mode-skips-required-only
vectors.description: mode=draft: REQUIRED is not enforced but type errors still are; required map is unchanged.

vectors.name: unknown-key-submitted
vectors.description: A submitted key that is not a field (or is a non-input SECTION_HEADING / HELP_TEXT) yields UNKNOWN_FIELD.

vectors.name: def-circular-two-fields
vectors.description: a shows when b is true, b shows when a is true: CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY.

vectors.name: def-circular-three-mixed-rule-kinds
vectors.description: Cycle across showWhen, requiredWhen and an option availableWhen: a -> b -> c -> a.

vectors.name: def-circular-through-section
vectors.description: The heading depends on a member of its own section: member -> heading -> member.

vectors.name: def-self-reference-show-when
vectors.description: A field may not reference itself.

vectors.name: def-self-reference-option-rule
vectors.description: An option rule may not reference its own field.

vectors.name: def-unknown-field-reference
vectors.description: Rule references a field that is not in the form.

vectors.name: def-reference-to-heading
vectors.description: Rules may not reference SECTION_HEADING or HELP_TEXT fields.

vectors.name: def-rule-too-deep
vectors.description: and > or > not > leaf has depth 4 (> 3): RULE_TOO_DEEP.

vectors.name: def-operator-type-mismatch-ordering-on-select
vectors.description: Ordering operators are not allowed on SELECT.

vectors.name: def-operator-type-mismatch-istrue-on-text
vectors.description: isTrue only applies to CHECKBOX.

vectors.name: def-literal-type-mismatch
vectors.description: NUMBER compared with a string literal.

vectors.name: def-unknown-option-reference
vectors.description: Rule literal is not a declared option key of the referenced SELECT.

vectors.name: def-duplicate-field-key
vectors.description: Two fields share a key.

vectors.name: def-duplicate-option-key
vectors.description: Two options of one field share a key.

vectors.name: def-rule-fails-json-schema
vectors.description: Unknown operator "xor" violates the rule JSON schema.

vectors.name: def-invalid-section
vectors.description: section must name an existing SECTION_HEADING.
